decisive_items: Proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells originated from one lateral end, pushing down into the dermis and involving many hairs
Malignant squamous cells contained eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli; mitotic figures were present
Negative immunohistochemical stains for adipophilin and androgen receptor
response.rationale: R2 is directly supported by squamous proliferation, pseudohorn cysts, and malignant squamous features. R1 is contradicted by negative adipophilin/androgen receptor stains despite PAS-positive clear cells. R3 lacks support and is contradicted by squamous proliferation.

rejected.why: Clear cell change and PAS positivity are nonspecific; negative adipophilin and androgen receptor exclude sebaceous carcinoma.
No supporting spans; squamous proliferation and hair involvement contradict basal cell carcinoma.
